Related skills: clear-thinking-book (cognitive biases), nonviolent-communication (inquiry), the-mountain-is-you (self-awareness), the-art-of-thinking-clearly (thinking patterns).
skills.name: change-your-questions-change-your-life

Related skills: antifragile (benefiting from disorder), fooled-by-randomness (probability traps), predictably-irrational (cognitive biases), clear-thinking-book (decision making), the-art-of-thinking-clearly (biases).

skills.description: Michelle Alexander's The New Jim Crow — an executable toolkit for understanding mass incarceration as a racial caste system in America: its history, mechanisms, human impact, and what can be done about it.
